report: Verified current validate.rs and value_types.rs exactly match historical reviewed source; independently reassessed the complete current claim and associated evidence. Both ordinary implementation associations cover unknown local/prelude names and qualified lookup failures in resolve_type. Its recursive tuple-member and generic-argument traversal propagates errors. Model::check_values applies it to every struct field and both named and tuple variant payloads; Model::check applies it to class/context fields and method results. Thus every stated type use site rejects unknown names, including nesting. The complete associated test unknown_nested_names_are_rejected_at_each_type_use_site exercises all six forms: struct Option<(bool, Missing)>, tuple variant Vec<Missing>, named variant (Missing, bool), class and context Vec<Missing> fields, and Option<Missing> method results. Each iteration asserts exactly one diagnostic and the unknown type Missing message. Captured parse_body/check helper context confirms each body is parsed with unwrap and validated, so parser failure cannot masquerade as success. Source reasoning and these meaningful assertions support all claim aspects and the prior rationale. There are no TODO/N/A entries or deferrals. Review performed by source inspection and exact baseline comparison; no behavior tests or builds were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported suite/build results are separate execution evidence. No edits needed.
